children.content: PAMA is at the service of its customers and provides support to satisfy all their needs even for the most difficult machine tool applications.

children.name: solution-inner-body
children.content: From plant configuration to technology services, a dedicated project manager supports every customer through the full production process.

children.name: products-copy
children.content: PAMA’s machine tools provide optimal precision and precisely perform boring, drilling, milling and turning operations, satisfying customer requirements in the most demanding industries.

children.name: product-card-1-body
children.content: Portal and T-type structures designed for maximum versatility and high precision.

children.name: product-card-2-body
children.content: Central headstock milling machines built for dynamics, reliability and precision.

children.name: product-card-3-body
children.content: High metal-removal boring and milling machines for demanding industrial work.

children.name: support-body
children.content: PAMA is proud of its many years of experience in the field of machine tools and provides its customers with a wide range of services and contracts to ensure the sustained highest level of performance of its products.

children.name: support-body-2
children.content: From dedicated helpline and remote diagnosis to preventative maintenance and machine geometry optimisation, PAMA keeps machine tools productive over time.

children.name: page-sector-para-0
children.content: With more than 90 years of work experience in boring and milling machines and machining centres, PAMA is the ideal partner for companies who operate in sectors that require high precision, optimal performance and maximum reliability.

children.name: page-sector-para-1
children.content: PAMA is an Italian machine tool manufacturer : it does not simply offer a product but guarantees know-how and expert technicians and is specialised in various areas of expertise.

children.name: page-sector-para-2
children.content: With almost a century of experience and a research & development department that constantly studies and works on new technologies, PAMA develops and manufactures Italian machine tools - boring machines, milling machines and machining centres - for various sectors, guaranteeing quality and reliability.

children.content: PAMA offers products tested and developed for the processing of hard materials such as titanium, Inconel and steel alloys, the main applications found in the aerospace sector .
